sections.heading: Forming the conditionnel passé
sections.body: The **conditionnel passé** ("would have") is the auxiliary in the **conditionnel présent** + past participle:

sections.heading: Regret
sections.body:
- *J'aurais aimé* / *J'aurais voulu* + infinitive — I would have liked to: *J'aurais aimé voyager plus quand j'étais jeune.*
- *J'aurais dû* + infinitive — I should have: *J'aurais dû t'écouter.* (I should have listened to you.)
- *J'aurais pu* + infinitive — I could have: *J'aurais pu réussir.*
- *Si seulement…* + plus-que-parfait: *Si seulement j'avais su !*

sections.heading: Reproach and advice about the past
sections.body:
- *Tu aurais dû me prévenir !* — You should have warned me!
- *Vous auriez pu appeler !* — You could have called!
- *Il aurait mieux valu partir plus tôt.* — It would have been better to leave earlier.
- *À ta place, je n'aurais rien dit.* — In your place, I wouldn't have said anything.

sections.heading: Unconfirmed information (journalism)
sections.body: News reports use the conditional to report information that isn't confirmed: the present for current facts, the past for past events: *Le président serait malade.* (The president is said to be ill.) *L'incendie aurait fait trois victimes.* (The fire reportedly claimed three victims.) *Selon nos informations, le ministre aurait démissionné.* (According to our information, the minister has reportedly resigned.) The meaning is "it is said / reportedly" — the journalist doesn't vouch for it.

examples: J'aurais aimé voyager plus quand j'étais jeune.
I would have liked to travel more when I was young.
J'aurais dû t'écouter.
I should have listened to you.
J'aurais pu réussir si j'avais travaillé.
I could have succeeded if I had worked.
Tu aurais dû me prévenir !
You should have warned me!
Vous auriez pu appeler !
You could have called!
Il aurait mieux valu partir plus tôt.
It would have been better to leave earlier.
À ta place, je n'aurais rien dit.
In your place, I wouldn't have said anything.
Sans toi, je ne serais jamais venue.
Without you, I'd never have come.
L'incendie aurait fait trois victimes.
The fire reportedly claimed three victims.
Selon nos informations, le ministre aurait démissionné.
According to our information, the minister has reportedly resigned.
Le président serait malade.
The president is said to be ill.
Nous serions arrivés à l'heure sans les embouteillages.
We'd have arrived on time without the traffic jams.
